notes.title: Emmerholt : Prologue Patch Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Thanks to everyone that has been playing Emmerholt, we've really enjoyed working on this demo and are looking forward to making something epic from here. Your feedback is highly appreciated and helps us improve the game. With that being said we know that we have a large gap to cross for our full vision of the game and what we have now in this demo.  For Emmerholt you can expect a large explorable world, diverse environments, a deep story, bustling towns, and lots of magic to play with. This is just the beginning.

 Emmerholt : Prologue Patch Update 1.01

We have gone back to our demo and fixed some of the biggest issues people were having. 

 Performance Update

 Increased FPS of the game heavily. Emmerholt now runs at 90FPS on our GTX 970 I5.


 Visual Update

 Added in increased default supersampling to reduce the blurriness. 


 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that was causing tutorial portions to remain on screen
 Fixed an issue that was causing frame drops during combat
 Fixed an issue that was causng the game to crash when selecting a locomotion type.
  Fixed an issue that was stopping people from being able to proceed past the door at the fishery.
  Fixed an issue that was causing debug text to appear on screen.


If you have any more suggestions for the full game feel to share them on our  discussions page. We love talking with the community and believe that working together helps us make more awesome games.

-Oneiric Devs
